blockbench_rules.selection_rule: Inspect the blockstate first, then open the referenced model JSON from models/block rather than opening the blockstate JSON itself.
blockbench_rules.multipart_rule: If the blockstate is multipart, open each referenced model JSON or use display.json when present for an easier single-file preview.
blockbench_rules.vanilla_dependency_rule: If a model references minecraft:block/... or minecraft:item/..., it is not fully self-contained and needs a vanilla asset decision before export.
